description: Resume a paused mailbox, so campaigns, warmup and direct sends can use it again. While a copy of old mail to our servers holds the mailbox's sending (get_mailbox_migration's `hold`), it answers 409 `migrationHoldsMailbox` and nothing changes: the mailbox resumes by itself once our team copies the last mail, unless it was paused before or during the copy. To send sooner, cancel the copy with cancel_mailbox_migration.

idempotencyKey.description: Your own id for this one call, such as a UUID, up to 255 characters. If the call fails with no answer, call again with the same key and the same arguments: within 24 hours, a saved answer comes back instead of a second run. A call left unanswered can run again after 15 minutes, so a send also keeps its intentKey or draft revision.

name: resume_mailbox
title: Resume a mailbox
